basis: sum of gateway-reported cost of every request (all 36 attempts report it; no failed request retained a reserved maximum); equals the BudgetLedger incurred total printed by the runner (progress.jsonl spent_total 0.208717694)
why_they_differ: the runner attributes each attempt's cost as the ledger delta between its start and end; with --concurrency 2 the two in-flight attempts' charges overlap, so each attempt was also charged part of the other's requests (over-attribution, never under). The cap check uses the BudgetLedger's real incurred total, not the attributed sum. The per-condition cost column in REPORT.md uses the attributed amounts.
